consequence.statement: Only the metric's help text changes; no operational consequence for operators.

original.statement: The help text of the certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds metric was corrected to say it is a Unix epoch timestamp rather than relative to expiration time.

decision.reason: [ev-2a805da381d1] describes this only as a fix to the metric's help text: it now says the metric is Unix epoch time rather than relative to expiration time. Nothing in it says the metric's name, values or behaviour changed, or that anything fails or needs operator action. So "none" (informational) is supported.
